What this rust reference models

Chosen FeOOH-equivalent chemistry, first-order capacity law and attached/sediment partition; real rust is a mixture. Uniform shells and beds are volume references, not protective-layer or floc morphology predictions. Procedural surface roughness is illustrative, not measured grain geometry. Wet-cell water is accessible through a zero-volume schematic wick; wetting and transport are not solved. Fixed 25 °C ideal O₂/N₂ gas; no vapour, dissolved-oxygen storage, heat, pH, anaerobic pathway or settling solver. The half-shell cutaway is a diagnostic view. Drawing densities are 8/4.2/1 g/mL.
